body:
Document the complete integrated Contour sequence from #4204 after its implementation issues finish.
Depend on the core, source, safety and UI issues linked from #4204.

Update these guides:
- site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md.
- site/content/guide/getting-started/workflows.md.
- The generated MCP documentation and its source.

Explain the Passes controls and their defaults.
Show the formula for S, A and N. Use the 0.30, 0.15, 0, 0 example.
Explain that final Stock to leave remains and spring passes repeat the final wall path.
Explain finish-feed inheritance, enable-time copying and explicit overrides.
Explain that all passes reuse the lead settings and retract safely between radial bands.
State the existing compensation restrictions and the later-pass refusal behavior.
Keep the separate rough and finish operation workflow for jobs that need another tool or entry strategy.
Keep Pocket finishing separate from repeating an area-clearing path.

Done means: the operation guide and workflow agree with the implemented behavior.
MCP documentation lists optional fields, count ranges, null removal and omitted-field preservation.
Examples distinguish finishing allowance from final stock and spring passes.
Documentation checks and relevant generated-document checks pass.

Effort: medium. This work updates several documentation surfaces through existing patterns. It changes no generated motion.
Priority: P7. This issue supplies documentation owed by the implementation.

Part of #4204
